getTemplatePickerCovers: Called only by the template picker that showTemplates opens in clients that can show it. showTemplates answers the templates in n8n.
getReportMessageProgress: Called only by the progress view that sendReportMessage opens in clients that can show it. getReportMessage answers the same progress.
getReportViewerSlideImages: Called only by the report viewer that showReport opens in clients that can show it. getReportSlideImages renders the same slides.
confirmAction: Called only by the confirmation card Rollstack shows before a call that emails people or deletes reports, with a token only that card has. In n8n, you confirm such a call in Rollstack, at the link the operation answers.
